 Okan Buruk will break Fatih Terim's record! The interesting part is something else.
 20.11.2026 10:30
 Galatasaray head coach Okan Buruk is preparing to go down in club history in the Samsunspor match. If the yellow-reds leave the match without defeat, they will extend their home unbeaten streak to 42 matches, and Buruk will surpass Fatih Terim's 41-match record. The fact that the match will be played at the stadium bearing Fatih Terim's name has brought along a striking coincidence.
 Galatasaray, who are continuing their title challenge in the Super Lig, aim to achieve a historic success against Samsunspor. The yellow-and-reds under head coach Okan Buruk have not suffered a defeat in their last 41 home matches in the league.
 If Galatasaray also preserve their unbeaten run against Samsunspor, they will extend their streak to 42 matches. Thus, Okan Buruk will surpass Fatih Terim's 41-match home unbeaten record.
 OKAN BURUK WILL AGAIN BREAK FATIH TERIM'S RECORD
 Galatasaray's legendary head coach Fatih Terim achieved a 41-match home unbeaten streak in the Super Lig between 2017 and 2019. Okan Buruk equalled that record with the result against Amed in the 11th week of this season.
 What is interesting is that the head coach who ended Fatih Terim's unbeaten streak was also Okan Buruk. The experienced coach, while at the helm of Başakşehir in the 12th week of the 2019-2020 season, beat Galatasaray 1-0 away and ended Terim's streak.
 HE CAN BREAK THE RECORD AT FATIH TERIM'S STADIUM
 The stadium where the historic match will be played also draws attention. Due to deterioration in the pitch of RAMS Park, it was stated that the Galatasaray-Samsunspor match will be played at Başakşehir Fatih Terim Stadium. Thus, Okan Buruk will have the opportunity to break the record belonging to the experienced coach at the stadium bearing the name of Fatih Terim, with whom he once worked.
 THEY HAVE NOT SEEN DEFEAT FOR 41 MATCHES
 Galatasaray experienced their last home defeat in the Super Lig in the 37th week of the 2023-2024 season against Fenerbahçe with a 1-0 score. The yellow-and-reds' unbeaten streak began with a 2-1 victory over Hatayspor in the first week of the 2024-2025 season.
 Galatasaray achieved 15 wins and 3 draws at home in the 2024-2025 season. The yellow-and-reds, who got 13 wins and 4 draws the following season, have had 5 wins and 1 draw in the 6 home matches they have played this season. Thus, Galatasaray have continued their unbeaten streak with 33 wins and 8 draws in a total of 41 matches.
 THEY LOST ONLY 2 TIMES IN 78 MATCHES
 Galatasaray under Okan Buruk have played 78 home matches in the Super Lig to date. The yellow-and-reds earned 66 wins and 10 draws in these matches, while leaving the field in defeat only 2 times.
 OKAN BURUK'S RECORDS DRAW ATTENTION
 Okan Buruk, who has managed Galatasaray since the 2022-2023 season, has achieved many successes at the yellow-and-red club. Galatasaray collected 102 points in the 2023-2024 season and achieved 33 wins in the same season. The yellow-and-reds under Buruk also managed to surpass the 90-point threshold in two consecutive seasons. The experienced coach also reached 75 wins in the Super Lig in 90 matches, and 50 away wins in 64 matches. Among Buruk's notable achievements in his Galatasaray career are a 17-match winning streak, a 17-match away winning streak, and scoring in 35 consecutive home matches. Buruk, who experienced 7 Super Lig championships as a footballer and 5 as a head coach, has a total of 12 championships.
 THE RECORD IN THE SUPER LIG BELONGS TO TRABZONSPOR
 The longest home unbeaten streak in Super Lig history belongs to Trabzonspor with 90 matches. Fenerbahçe with 73 matches and Beşiktaş with 51 matches follow the maroon-blue team.
